neighbours.label: the verb or article that introduces a formula or formal definition (is given by, can be expressed in the form, can be written as), as against the same verbs in ordinary statements
fire: For a spring, the restoring force is given by F = -kx, where k is the stiffness.
Every complex number can be expressed in the form z = a + bi.
The area of a circle is given by the expression A = pi r^2.
Using Ohm's law, the current can be written as I = V / R.
In this model, the growth rate is defined as the change in size per day.
Any even number can be expressed as the sum of two odd numbers.
The probability of two heads is given by the product of the single probabilities.
The total cost can be written in the form C = F + vq.
quiet: For a spring, the restoring force is weak when the coil is old.
Every complex number was given a colour on the teacher's chart.
The area of a circle is given to pupils as homework on Fridays.
Using Ohm's law, the students wrote their answers on the board.
In this model, the growth rate is shown on a blue line.
Any even number was written in red on the poster.
The probability lesson is taught by Mr Hart every Tuesday.
The total cost was written on the back of the receipt.
